import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, m, modulus = map(int, input[:3])
    data = list(map(int, input[3:]))

    MAX = 500
    comb = [[0] * (MAX + 1) for _ in range(MAX + 1)]
    dpA_first = [0] * (m + 1)
    dpA_second = [0] * (m + 1)
    dpB_first = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(n + 1)] for _ in range(2)]
    dpB_second = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(n + 1)] for _ in range(2)]

    def update(x, y):
        x += y
        if x >= modulus:
            x -= modulus
        return x

    def total_sum(n):
        return n * (n + 1) // 2

    # Build combination table
    for i in range(m + 1):
        comb[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            comb[i][j] = update(comb[i][j], comb[i - 1][j])
            comb[i][j] = update(comb[i][j], comb[i - 1][j - 1])

    # Initialize dpA
    dpA_first[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            w = (dpA_first[j - 1] * dpA_first[i - j]) % modulus
            w = (w * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % modulus
            sum_val = (total_sum(j - 1) + total_sum(i - j)) % modulus
            dpA_second[i] = update(dpA_second[i], sum_val * w % modulus)
            dpA_second[i] = update(dpA_second[i], dpA_second[j - 1] * dpA_first[i - j] % modulus * (i + 1) * comb[i - 1][j - 1] % modulus)
            dpA_second[i] = update(dpA_second[i], dpA_first[j - 1] * dpA_second[i - j] % modulus * (i + 1) * comb[i - 1][j - 1] % modulus)
            dpA_first[i] = update(dpA_first[i], w * (i + 1) % modulus)

    # Initialize dpB
    dpB_first[0][0][0] = 1
    dpB_first[1][0][0] = 1

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            for ln in range(1, n - i + 1):
                # Update dpB[1]
                dpB_first[1][i + ln][j] = update(dpB_first[1][i + ln][j], dpB_first[0][i][j])
                dpB_second[1][i + ln][j] = update(dpB_second[1][i + ln][j], dpB_second[0][i][j])

                # Update dpB[0]
                val1 = (dpB_first[1][i][j] * dpA_first[ln]) % modulus
                val1 = (val1 * comb[j + ln][j]) % modulus
                dpB_first[0][i + ln][j + ln] = update(dpB_first[0][i + ln][j + ln], val1)

                val2 = (dpB_first[1][i][j] * dpA_second[ln]) % modulus
                val2 = (val2 * comb[j + ln][j]) % modulus
                dpB_second[0][i + ln][j + ln] = update(dpB_second[0][i + ln][j + ln], val2)

                val3 = (dpB_second[1][i][j] * dpA_first[ln]) % modulus
                val3 = (val3 * comb[j + ln][j]) % modulus
                dpB_second[0][i + ln][j + ln] = update(dpB_second[0][i + ln][j + ln], val3)

    result = dpB_second[0][n][m]
    result = update(result, dpB_second[1][n][m])
    print(result)

main()
